children: Electra released a newsletter outlining partnerships, product updates and progress toward a business combination with Iron Horse.
Electra announced a technical collaboration with MinTech to feed battery diagnostics into its AI Brain for Batteries™ for BESS risk prediction.
Electra disclosed a partnership with Omega Seiki Mobility to integrate real-time battery intelligence into its EV ecosystem.
Iron Horse and Electra plan to file a Form S-4; a Proxy Statement/Prospectus will be mailed to Iron Horse shareholders for approval.
Newsletter includes forward-looking statements on expected benefits, timing and market adoption and warns of related risks and uncertainties.
